scope: Single-host, single-pattern exploratory sustained direct-read measurement; not an ABBA comparison or complete formal F1 certification
preparation: 16 MiB instrument controls and 64 MiB 15-second smoke observed before this protocol. No sustained arm yet.
hardware: Windows laptop; C: on PhysicalDrive0, Micron MTFDKCD512QFM-1BD1AABLA; one physical SSD; combined-drive test not applicable
reading: Sequential 4 MiB aligned direct reads using Soup open_direct; wrap at EOF; 32 GiB random-byte fixture
start_conditions: Close nonessential applications and pause voluntary downloads/sync
Wait until disk temperature is at most 40 C before starting
Keep laptop on a hard ventilated surface and prevent sleep during this run
stopping: Temperature at or above 65 C: operational cutoff, not manufacturer rating

plots: physical-disk read and write counter deltas
analysis.summary: Report whole-run and post-600s throughput, with nonoverlapping 60-second time-weighted windows. Preserve final partial window separately.
analysis.planner_rule: 0.9 times the 10th percentile (linear interpolation) of complete post-warmup 60-second throughput windows; heuristic for this host and read pattern, not a confidence bound
analysis.invalid: Incomplete duration, failed required F1 check, safety stop, changed source/fixture, missing counters: exclude from planner recommendation; preserve all logs
analysis.attribution: Correlate dips with temperature, physical-disk activity and recorded process reads. Temporal association alone is not thermal causation; unexplained dips remain unknown.

limitations: One run and one pattern: no repeatability or comparative speedup claim
Windows F1 process I/O is logical and covers all devices; physical counters are aggregate, not per-process attribution
F1 ok does not establish absence of all background I/O; writes and paging can affect throughput
Sensor polling cannot interrupt a hung kernel I/O
No GPU or Soup training throughput claim; this is a Soup-reader disk primitive
If background activity prevents attribution, report inconclusive rather than relaxing thresholds after observing results
